The Base Condition:
Irreconcilable Antagonism
THE STATE
Arises from society but
places itself above it to
enforce "order"
Society splits into
classes with conflicting
economic interests.
The conflict cannot be
objectively reconciled.
The state is a product and a manifestation of the irreconcilability of class antagonisms.

The Engineer's Critique: Fifty Years Later
In 1970, Marxist scholar Ralph
Miliband analyzes The State and
Revolution. He recognizes it as a
sacred text of anti-bureaucratic
thought, but notes a glaring
absence in its engineering.
THE CORE ARGUMENT:
The blueprint takes the "withering
away" of the state so far that the
revolutionary power is already at
an advanced stage of
decomposition on the very
morrow of the revolution.
"The exercise of socialist
power remains the Achilles'
heel of Marxism."
- R. Miliband

The Missing Gear: Political Mediation
O O
The Proletariat

THE PARTY
POLITICAL MEDIATION
State of Armed
Workers
(Superstructure)
THE OMISSION:
In The State and Revolution, the
Party is almost entirely absent.
There are no mechanics explaining
how the Party interacts with the
armed workers.
THE IMPLICATION:
Lenin assumes an automatic, symbiotic
relationship between the class and the
party-an assumption that belongs to
the rhetoric of power, not to its reality.'

The Blueprint vs. Reality
1917: Unmediated Class Rule
1919-1921: The Party State
The state, that is the proletariat
armed and organized as the ruling
class.
(No mention of a ruling party)
Lenin recognizes the necessity of the
Party for actual governance.
1919: "Yes, the dictatorship of one party! we
stand upon it..'
1921: " the dictatorship of the proletariat is
impossible except through the Communist Party."

The Myth of the Undivided Will
The People / Multiple Wills
The Party
The Party
THE FLAW:
Single-party rule postulates an
undivided, revolutionary
proletarian will of which the Party
is the natural expression.
Single-Party Will
Revolutionary Red
MILIBAND'S REALITY:
In no society is there an
undivided, single popular will.
THE CONSEQUENCE:
Without alternative channels of
expression, the Central Committee
inevitably substitutes itself for
the party, and a dictator for the
Committee.

THE FLAW:
Lenin overestimated how
fast the state could
"wither away" and
ignored the mechanics of

THE GENIUS:

administration of society
is not a distant hope,
but an immediate
operational requirement.
